description: A constitutionally inalienable land donation to the etzhayyim Land Trust. Per ADR-2605192245 (4-layer permanent record) + ADR-2605192100 §1.11 (Earth as Tree of Life body). The on-chain side mints a non-transferable LandRegistry NFT to the Land Trust treasury; this Lexicon record is the AT Protocol counterpart (Layer 4-adjacent — references the on-chain NFT and the IPFS-pinned content). Once recorded, this donation is WAQF-EQUIVALENT INALIENABLE — no transfer, sale, burn, or substitution is permitted. See `90-docs/2605220540-first-land-donation-walkthrough.md`.

donorDid.description: DID of the donor at the moment of donation. Per `FORK-BOOTSTRAP.md` constitutional invariant #2, donor must operate a religious DID (did:web / did:plc / did:key).

parcelName.description: Human-readable parcel name as the donor wishes it to be recorded. Religious-corps may add stewardship-given names later; the donor's original name is preserved here.

jurisdictionalId.description: State-cadastre identifier(s). May include multiple if the parcel straddles jurisdictions (semicolon-separated). The religious-corp records this for transparency; it does not assert state recognition of the donation.

geojsonCid.description: IPFS CID of the RFC 7946 GeoJSON FeatureCollection defining the parcel boundary.

titleCidEncrypted.description: IPFS CID of the donor's title document, XChaCha20-Poly1305-wrapped per ADR-2605181100 (`com.etzhayyim.encrypted.land-title.*`). Decryption is permitted to: donor, Council Seat 5 (Stewardship/Land), Council Seat 1 (Founder).

environmentalCid.description: IPFS CID of the environmental statement (free-form markdown + photo references).

photoCids.description: Optional IPFS CIDs of supplementary photos (current land state, boundary markers, biodiversity evidence, etc.).

tokenId.description: Base L2 LandRegistry ERC-721 token ID (unsigned, no implied units — token IDs are unitless serial integers).

txHash.description: Hex-encoded 32-byte transaction hash of the LandRegistry.donate() call. Prefix `0x`, lowercase. Used to anchor the Layer-1 on-chain NFT to this Layer-4-adjacent AT Protocol record.

stewardDids.description: DIDs of named stewards. The donor's DID may be included (typical) or omitted (anonymous stewardship via Council Seat 5 only). Stewards retain voice over land management but never ownership. Per ADR-2605192245.

donorNoteRef.description: Optional AT URI of an `com.etzhayyim.encrypted.donation-note` record carrying a private message from the donor to the Council. Use when the donor wishes to record reasoning or context confidentially.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp at the moment of donation submission.
